shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,85p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && rg -n -C 3 '@gravity-ui/table|@gravity-ui/uikit' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md"

/bin/bash -lc ".agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Table withTableSorting withTableSelection Pagination Button TextInput Select Modal DropdownMenu Text Label && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit | rg '/(Table|Pagination|Select|Modal|DropdownMenu|Button|TextInput)/.*(d.ts|README.md)"'$'"'"

/bin/bash -lc "curl -fsSL https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt -o /tmp/gravity-uikit-docs.txt && rg -n '"'^#.*(Table|Pagination|Select|Modal|DropdownMenu|Button|TextInput)|withTableSorting|withTableSelection'"' /tmp/gravity-uikit-docs.txt | head -65 && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/icons.md && rg --files -g '*lock*' -g '"'!node_modules'"' && cat tsconfig.json"

/bin/bash -lc "bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Table withTableSorting withTableSelection Pagination Button TextInput Select Modal DropdownMenu Text Label; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/icons.md; cat tsconfig.json; rg --files -g '*lock*' -g '"'!node_modules'"'"

/bin/bash -lc 'wc -c /tmp/gravity-uikit-docs.txt /tmp/gravity-icons.html; head -c 300 /tmp/gravity-uikit-docs.txt; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.js; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.js; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownMenu.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Modal/Modal.d.ts'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'export|search|magnifier|download|person|circle-check|sliders|gear|moon|sun|layers|ellipsis|plus|chevron|arrow-up-right' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts | head -45; rg -n -- '--g-table|padding|height' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/Table.css | head -45; sed -n '1,130p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/types.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts; rg -n 'base-(utility|info)|text-(utility|positive)|line-generic' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'Table|Pagination|Button|TextInput' /tmp/gravity-uikit-docs.txt | head -25; rg -n \"Magnifier|ArrowDownToLine|Persons|PersonPlus|CircleCheck|Sliders|Gear|Moon|Sun|CircleQuestion|ChevronDown|ArrowUpRight|Layers|Ellipsis|Plus|Xmark|Clock|ChartColumn|LayoutColumns|SquareList\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts; rg -o -- '--g-color-(base|text)-(utility|info|positive|misc)[a-z-]*' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | sort -u; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/README.md | head -65; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/Table.css | head -95; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -100"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -o -- '--g-color-(base|text)-(utility|info|positive|misc)[a-z-]*' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/themes/_light.scss | sort -u; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles | head -18; cat index.html; rg -n 'utility|positive' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/themes/_light.scss | head -18; rg -o '.{0,35}magnifier.{0,45}' /tmp/gravity-icons.html | head -3"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/themes/light/base.scss | head -85; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/themes/light/text.scss | head -65; rg 'export.*(Sun|Xmark)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts; cat package.json"
